The identifiers are unchanged by renaming. The bounds check is separate, required, and commutes with clipping the orientation to visible identifiers.

The extracted formula has only one- and two-literal clauses. The in-tree theorem TwoSat.sat_iff verifies the exact executable small-clause bounded implication closure used here. Unit-test self-reduction constructs a certified flip assignment from the occurring variable IDs only.

The automatic oriented solver is decisive on recognized inputs, restores witnesses for the original encoded formula, and returns unsupported when no valid orientation exists. This is the zero-backdoor fragment of the guarded input representation.
